issue: Conditional full-source compression changes enumeration cost but does not acquire hidden mobility
clarification: N798 removes hidden-bath state enumeration under supplied global source/form envelopes and shows compact analytic tensor witnesses. Source-aware Schur composition and normalized bounds retain the full equilibrium source. This is a conditional representation improvement over explicit-state N795, not a contradiction of N793 identical-static-data hidden-mobility obstructions. Envelope acquisition, strong comparators and severe-rarity failures stay open.

N791 intended residual,full-support reset/twirl and uniform error assumptions are not supplied by these molecular calculations.
